Honest Reaction $17.05 Simply Southern Cafe Baked Chicken Plate Was Hitting

$17.05 got me baked chicken, dressing, collards, lima beans, broccoli cheese casserole, muffins, cranberry sauce, and hot sauce… and honestly? This one felt like somebody auntie made sure I left full. The baked chicken was tender, the dressing mixed with cranberry sauce was dangerous, and once them collards met that hot sauce it was over with.
